_about: Agenda Ahead Wave 1 test (2026-10): 50 more New York towns, cities and villages with battery-storage moratoria, local laws or active data-center fights (Carina BESS Moratorium Monitor, the NY pilot's next-50 list, research notes). Same row shape as towns_ny.json plus kind, selection_group / selection_reason / selection_source. Built by `python3 experiments/wave1_test.py discover`. Kept outside data/towns_*.json because New York is a published state; promotion = moving these rows into data/towns_ny.json.
gate_note: Wave 1 test towns: not part of the production daily run or site (this file is outside the data/towns_*.json glob). Crawled only by `python3 -m watch351.daily --data-dir ../data/test/wave1/config --states NY --output-dir ../data/test/wave1/ny --hits-name hits_ny_wave1.json` (experiments/wave1_test.py crawl).
evidence_rule: a board is automated only if its listing shows >=1 agenda/packet/notice dated within [today-120d, today+120d] and the first such document is fetchable under robots.txt
